title: Design and Validation of a Multi-Tier Microsoft 365 Backup Architecture
description: A sanitized enterprise case study of Microsoft 365 protection using a four-node primary backup cluster, a controlled Windows recovery connector, Veritas NetBackup MSDP, and LTO-9 long-term retention. The implementation validates protection, Exchange Online PST recovery, application-level content access, secondary disk backup, and tape duplication while explicitly documenting the tests that remain for production readiness.
notes: Public sanitized edition. Organization-specific and security-sensitive operational identifiers have been removed.
